Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.audit

Record Class KfeAuditRootResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.audit.KfeAuditRootResponse
Record Components:
merkleRoot - root digest calculated from the included event hashes
eventCount - number of events committed to the root
fromSequence - first event sequence included, or null for an empty chain
toSequence - last event sequence included, or null for an empty chain
generatedAt - time when the root was computed
public record KfeAuditRootResponse(String merkleRoot, long eventCount, Long fromSequence, Long toSequence, LocalDateTime generatedAt) extends Record
Integrity summary over a contiguous range of persisted audit events.
